question: which LPBF machine maker in mainland China publishes its data openly, for a full-size study print of a part of about 118 x 229 x 95 mm
answer: None publishes everything a build simulation needs. Eplus3D publishes the most: it is the only maker read that states a spot size and an oxygen level in a datasheet, and the only one that gives an aluminium thermal conductivity. Kings publishes the most complete machine sheet but no alloy data; Farsoon states open parameters most clearly but no spot size or oxygen level.
